historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr (equity CAGR rejected: book grows from ~55% earnings retention into low-yield cash, not from operating growth)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 5.44% diverges >30% from EPS 5yr CAGR 3.21% and revenue 5yr 4.12%: book value compounds by retaining earnings as cash earning ~1-1.5%, so equity growth overstates business growth. Base path runs BELOW the 3yr revenue CAGR because H1 FY2026 revenue fell 3.2% with operator capex in structural decline.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported OCF-capex less interest income; SBC zero): FY2020 1,631; FY2021 2,365; FY2022 3,091; FY2023 3,445; FY2024 4,395; FY2025 -340. FCF CAGRs not meaningful because FY2025 is negative (OCF fell 85% to 937.7 on receivable/contract-asset build as telecom operators stretched payments). The FY2025 figure is a working-capital event, not a margin event: operating EBITDA margin held at 3.25%.

scenario_narratives.base: Telecom operators' capex (China Telecom ~38% of revenue, other operators ~16%) keeps falling high-single digits a year as 5G build-out matures, dragging revenue down 2.5% in FY2026 and 1% in FY2027; AI+/AIDC services (~10% of revenue, +62% H1 FY2026) and non-operator government/enterprise digitalisation offset it from FY2028 to give ~2% growth. Operating EBITDA margin holds ~3.3-3.4% on cost discipline. FY2026 sees one more year of payment-stretch working-capital drain, then cash conversion returns to the FY2021-24 norm. The cash pile is real, and payout rises to >=46% by FY2028 as planned.
scenario_narratives.bull: AIDC EPCO and AI-application work scales into a genuine second engine (state AI-compute build-out, East-Data-West-Compute), the non-operator customer base (already ~44%) keeps compounding, and revenue returns to 3-4% growth by FY2028 with margin mix lifting EBITDA to ~3.9%. Operators normalise payment, the FY2025-26 receivable build partly unwinds, and higher payouts re-rate the stock toward its cash-adjusted value.
scenario_narratives.bear: Operator capex falls ~10%/yr for several years and the state-capex-dependent, ~100% China-concentrated book shrinks four years running; AIDC turns out to be low-margin construction and gross margin keeps sliding. State-owned customers continue to finance themselves through CCS's balance sheet: receivables and contract assets keep ballooning (~RMB7bn over FY2026-28) and some are impaired, so the cash pile that underpins most of the value is steadily consumed rather than distributed.

valuation_philosophy.summary: An asset-light, thin-margin (3.3% EBITDA) Chinese SOE contractor whose market cap roughly equals its net cash. The operating business is valued on owner FCF at an 8% CNY WACC with a low 8-12x terminal cap, and cash is added net of an operating requirement for the subcontractor-payables float. The gap between IV and price is the market's discount for cash that is retained at 1-1.5% yields, paid out at under half of earnings, and at risk of being absorbed by state-owned customers' payment stretch.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash accessibility: ~55% earnings retention into low-yield deposits; minorities realise value only through dividends (43% payout FY2025, plan >=46% by FY2028)
Working-capital drain: FY2025 OCF -85%, H1 FY2026 OCF -RMB7.9bn; contract assets up RMB6.2bn in six months
Telecom-operator capex decline (~54% of revenue) faster than AI+/AIDC can replace it
Gross margin erosion (11.3% FY2025 -> 10.0% H1 FY2026) on low-differentiation subcontracted work
~100% China concentration and state policy dependence; HKD/CNY translation
valuation_philosophy.dividend_stream_memo: Memo, not the house basis: capitalising only what minorities actually receive -- FY2025 DPS RMB0.2241 (~HKD0.263 at 1.1721), payout rising 43% -> >=46% by FY2028 (~HKD0.28) -- at the same 8% CNY rate with 1.5% growth gives ~HKD4.3/share, roughly today's price. The market is pricing the dividend stream and ascribing ~zero value to the retained cash pile; the house IV assumes that cash (net of a RMB7.5bn operating requirement) belongs to shareholders. Closing that gap needs a higher payout, a special dividend or buybacks -- the re-rating catalyst to watch.

inputs.share_count_basis: 6,926.018m H + domestic shares (share capital RMB6,926,018k at RMB1 par, H1 FY2026 interim); basic = diluted (no options/convertibles). Held flat: no SBC, no buybacks, no issuance since 2017.
inputs.cash_note: Jun-26 cash-like = cash & equivalents 7,534.9 + short-term deposits/restricted 2,410.4 + current portion of >1yr deposits 5,067.4 + >1yr deposits 10,395.5 (H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet). Borrowings 686.1. Lease liabilities (1,159.2) EXCLUDED: lease treatment (B).
inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment scheme in FY2025 annual or H1 FY2026 interim cash-flow statements (SBC-zero H-share SOE); EquityAwardTaxes 0 every period.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1721 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10T03:38Z). Parity check via USD crosses: HKD=X 7.8472 / CNY=X 6.683 = 1.1742, 0.2% tie. No A-share dual listing to parity-check the equity itself. All flows in RMB; per-share values converted RMB -> HKD at this rate; unsuffixed IVs are HKD.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~0.85 x ERP ~7.0% (China equity ERP incl. H-share/SOE governance discount) = ~7.8%, rounded to 8.0%. Company is net cash, so WACC = cost of equity. Same 8.0% in every scenario: risk is charged in the flows (WC drain, revenue decline, margin erosion) and the 30% bear weight, not stacked in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: FY2025 lease principal 522.5 + lease interest 47.4 = 570.0 (0.38% of revenue) charged via lease_cost_pct_path; D&A path is ex-ROU (MD&A D&A 1,007.4 of 1,630.3 total) so tax EBIT does not charge the lease twice; lease liabilities excluded from net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI (FY2025 profit 139.7, ~3.7% of profit) folded into the cash_tax_rate as attributable leakage: ~11-12% cash tax (466 paid on PBT 4,121) + ~3.5pp NCI = 15%. Check: FY0 EBIT 3,305 x 0.85 = 2,809 vs attributable NI 3,610 less after-tax interest/dividend/associate income (~850) = ~2,760. NCI not deducted in the bridge.
inputs.ebitda_basis: FY2025 operating EBITDA = PBT 4,121.2 + finance costs 86.8 - interest income 519.7 - FVOCI dividend income 309.5 - share of associates/JVs 125.9 + D&A 1,630.3 = 4,883.2 (3.25% of revenue). FY2024 same build 3.26%. H1 FY2026 operating profit on this basis rose ~3.6% YoY despite revenue -3.2% (SG&A -RMB476m).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF with non-US adaptations (dcf-methods routing row 'operating company, non-US'). CCS is an asset-light engineering/BPO services contractor (capex ~0.5-1% of revenue), not a bank, REIT or holdco; its value is a cash-flow stream plus a large net cash pile, so owner-FCF is the right engine. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry). SBC-zero market: house and street coincide, band_position null. Interest income (519.7) and FVOCI dividend income (309.5) and associate profits (125.9) stripped from the flows; the matching cash, equity instruments and associate stakes are in net cash / equity_bridge. Working-capital: a contractor's net WC is ~zero (Dec-25: receivables+contract assets+prepayments+inventory 83.5bn vs payables+contract liabilities+accruals 84.2bn), so wc_capture = 0 and the operator payment-stretch drain is modelled explicitly as an add-on in capex_pct_path year 1-3 (see capex_pct_note per scenario). Timing: FY0 = FY2025, year 1 = FY2026 full year, but net cash is the Jun-26 trough after the seasonal H1 outflow of 8,130.6 (OCF -7,943.8, capex -186.8); the equity_bridge adds that H1 outflow back so it is not counted both in the Jun-26 cash and in the FY2026 year-1 flow. buyback_cash 0: non-repurchaser; the flat count is natural (no SBC, no issuance). Market check: market cap ~RMB24.1bn vs Jun-26 net cash ~RMB24.7bn -- the market prices the operating business at roughly zero EV; the valuation therefore turns almost entirely on whether the cash is real and accessible to minorities (payout 43% FY2025, plan >=46% by FY2028) and whether operator payment-stretch keeps consuming it.

bear.ebitda_margin_note: Operators cut capex ~10%/yr and push price; AIDC wins are low-margin construction; gross margin keeps sliding as in H1 FY2026 (10.0%).
bear.capex_pct_note: Underlying 0.6% plus WC drain/receivable impairment of 2.0/1.7/1.2pp (~RMB7bn cumulative over FY2026-28) as state-owned customers keep stretching payment and contract assets age.

base.growth_rates_note: FY2026 -2.5% (H1 -3.2%; H2 cushioned by AIDC ramp). Operator-linked revenue (~54%) shrinks high-single digits/yr while AI+/AIDC (~10%, +62% H1) and non-operator digital work grow; mix crosses to modest growth by FY2028, 2% thereafter.
base.ebitda_margin_note: Anchored to FY2024/FY2025 3.25-3.26% operating EBITDA; H1 FY2026 cost cuts offset 0.3pp gross-margin slippage. Small mix lift only.
base.capex_pct_note: Underlying capex 0.6% (FY2025 0.51%, FY2021-24 0.8-1.3%). Year 1 adds 1.3pp (~RMB1.9bn) for a further operator payment-stretch WC drain in FY2026 (H1 FY2026 OCF RMB0.4bn worse than H1 FY2025), then WC neutral as in FY2021-24.

bull.ebitda_margin_note: AIDC EPCO, AI applications and smart-maintenance mix lifts margin ~0.6pp; still below a typical integrator because subcontractor-heavy delivery persists.
bull.capex_pct_note: Smaller FY2026 WC drain (0.6pp); slightly higher capex (0.7%) for AI/data-centre capability.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 10x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% because revenue depends on a single state-controlled customer group whose capex is in structural decline and FY2025 OCF fell 85% on payment stretch, so the downside is already visible in the cash flow. Base 50% because operating margin and H1 FY2026 operating profit held up. Bull cut to 20% because it needs AIDC scale, margin mix, and operator payment normalisation all at once.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
